r3_remediation.fix: src/plan_sink.rs prepare(): unsupported(group_pass_through_fill_opacity) for pass_through && fill_opacity < 1. caught()/deliver() helpers (catch_unwind -> Unavailable worker_panic|sink_panic) used by the serial and parallel paths; run_parallel takes an injectable ChunkFn, each worker loop runs under catch_unwind and on a crash sets abort, notifies and sends Message::Failed(worker_panic); StopWorkers RAII guard sets abort+notify_all on every exit of the delivering thread incl. unwind. src/lib.rs DESCRIPTOR unsupported/failure text updated.
